DAGITAB FESTIVAL TRAFFIC ADVISORY 

LOOK: Motorists are warned of moderate to heavy traffic flow along the national highway in Brgy. Poblacion that may result from the street dancing competition of the Digital Festival scheduled at 3 p.m. today, December 23. 

Road closure starts at 1 a.m. and will continue until 6 p.m. Motorists are advised to schedule their travels earlier and to avoid the affected roads. | City Government of Naga, Cebu #CDNDigital

For more news about Cebu and beyond, visit https://t.co/nWCmctdteW.
